## Purpose and Entry Points
Deepsec is a TypeScript/pnpm monorepo for agent-powered, resumable vulnerability review of existing repositories. The primary executable is the `deepsec` CLI at `packages/deepsec/src/cli.ts`. Its lifecycle commands initialize a `.deepsec` project mirror, scan code with local matchers, send candidates to AI reviewers, optionally revalidate/triage/enrich results, and render or export findings. A separate Next.js documentation site lives in `packages/website/`.

## CLI Orchestration and Project State
The CLI command layer is the control-plane boundary between a user/CI working tree and Deepsec’s persisted project data. `init` and `setup` coordinate repository analysis, configuration, model/credential routing, package installation, and restartable state; later commands operate from the generated project directory.
- `packages/deepsec/src/commands/init.ts`
- `packages/deepsec/src/commands/setup.ts`
- `packages/deepsec/src/setup/coordinator.ts`

Configuration and filesystem conventions are shared through core types, schemas, plugin interfaces, paths, and run/state abstractions:
- `packages/core/src/config.ts`
- `packages/core/src/schemas.ts`
- `packages/core/src/run.ts`

## Deterministic Candidate Scan
The scanner provides the inexpensive first stage: detect project technologies, select registered built-in and generated/declarative matchers, scan source files, and emit candidate records for review. Its large matcher catalog covers application endpoints/frameworks, AI-agent surfaces, secrets, infrastructure, and common vulnerability patterns; matchers are extensible through the core plugin contract.
- `packages/scanner/src/index.ts`
- `packages/scanner/src/detect-tech.ts`
- `packages/scanner/src/matcher-registry.ts`

## AI Review Pipeline
The processor consumes scan candidates and repository context, batches them into bounded prompts, invokes a selected coding-agent backend, and reconciles responses into persisted findings. It also supplies downstream stages: lightweight severity triage, enrichment, and revalidation. Agent implementations isolate provider-specific execution for Claude, Codex, and Pi behind a registry/shared type boundary.
- `packages/processor/src/index.ts`
- `packages/processor/src/batch.ts`
- `packages/processor/src/agents/registry.ts`

Prompt construction is a material quality/cost boundary: it assembles core instructions, relevant file language/context, matcher highlights, and slug-specific notes before model submission.
- `packages/processor/src/prompt/assemble.ts`
- `packages/processor/src/prompt/core.ts`

## Findings Lifecycle and Outputs
Command handlers connect stored records to human and CI-facing outputs: `process`, `revalidate`, `triage`, `enrich`, `report`, `export`, metrics, and PR comments. Findings have stable IDs and validated schemas in `core`; reports/export transform project-local state rather than serving an application API.
- `packages/deepsec/src/commands/process.ts`
- `packages/deepsec/src/commands/export.ts`
- `packages/deepsec/src/pr-comment.ts`

## Distributed Sandbox Execution
For large repositories, the sandbox subsystem partitions work, creates and coordinates Vercel Sandbox microVM workers, uploads a source tarball, downloads outputs, and merges records. The request proxy and setup flow enforce the key boundary: credentials remain host-side and worker network access is constrained around agent egress.
- `packages/deepsec/src/sandbox/orchestrator.ts`
- `packages/deepsec/src/sandbox/partitioner.ts`
- `packages/deepsec/src/sandbox/merge-records.ts`

## Runtime and External Boundaries
Primary runtime is Node.js/TypeScript managed as a pnpm workspace. AI calls default to Vercel AI Gateway but support direct OpenAI, Anthropic, or custom HTTPS providers; credential configuration stores environment-variable names rather than keys. Optional infrastructure is Vercel project linking and Vercel Sandbox. CI integration is represented by repository workflows, including Deepsec and live-sandbox workflows.
- `packages/deepsec/src/auth/model-route.ts`
- `packages/deepsec/src/auth/vercel-link.ts`
- `.github/workflows/deepsec.yml`
